select p.id,p.numberofcredit,VAL_NAME,b.name,REST,DUEREST, INTERESTREST,creditlineamount,dateofconclusion,duedatefirstcontract,
 case when nvl(fl.status ,0)=1then
0 else q.id end as
 TRPROCESSED,(select count(*) from cm_folderplace_info where creditid=p.id) qeydsayi,cr.description crtype,q_dat,q_rest,q_intrest,q_penya,
 case 
 when nvl(dueday,0) between 1 and 30 then 
 1
 when nvl(dueday,0) between 31 and 300000 then 
 2
 else
 0
 end as due/*,cm_utils.get_qetname(p.id,1)+cm_utils.get_qetname(p.id,2)+cm_utils.get_qetname(p.id,3) cemqet*/,
 b.phonenumber,gr.anyinfotodisting,gr.pledgeprice,g1.guarantorname z1nam,g1.zaminwork1 z1work,g1.zmtelmob1 z1tel
 ,g2.guarantorname z2nam,g2.zaminwork1 z2work,g2.zmtelmob1 z2tel,g3.guarantorname z3nam,g3.zaminwork1 z1work,g3.zmtelmob1 z3tel,
    LastintPaydate.paydat as lastintpaydate ,dLastintPaydate.paydat as dlastintpaydate ,
    LastMainPaydate.paydat as lastmainpaydate , dLastMainPaydate.paydat as dlastmainpaydate ,dLastMainPaydate.payeddueamt,
    LastintPaydate.payedintamt,LastMainPaydate.payedamt,dLastintPaydate.payeddueintamt,    
DUEINTERESTREST,REST+DUEREST+INTERESTREST+DUEINTERESTREST fullrest, dueday,q.id qovid,q.name qovluq,f.name filial,nvl(fl.status ,0)status,p.currency,p.BRANCHID,p.credittype from 
cm_active_credits p,cm_credittypes cr,
cm_curr_state h,cm_guarantee gr,
cm_boorowerinfo b,CM_GUARANTOR g1,CM_GUARANTOR g2,CM_GUARANTOR g3,
cm_qovluq q,
filial_t f,
avalute_t v,
cm_folderplace fl,
 ((select 
          id as creditid,
          null as paydat ,0 payedintamt
        from cm_portfolio 
       minus
       select 
       creditid ,
       null as paydat,0 payedintamt from cm_payments p
      where PAYEDINTAMT<>0  
      and PAYDATE in(select max(paydate) from cm_payments where paydate<=sbop.get_date and creditid=p.creditid)
      group by creditid)
      union all
      select 
       creditid ,
       max(PAYDATE) as paydat,sum(payedintamt)payedintamt from cm_payments p
      where PAYEDINTAMT<>0  
      and PAYDATE in(select max(paydate) from cm_payments where paydate<=sbop.get_date and creditid=p.creditid)
      group by creditid) LastintPaydate,     
      ((select 
          id as creditid,
          null as paydat,0 payedamt
        from cm_portfolio 
       minus
       select 
       creditid ,
       null as paydat,0 payedamt from cm_payments p
      where payedamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE in(select max(paydate) from cm_payments where paydate<=sbop.get_date and creditid=p.creditid)
      group by creditid)
      union all
      select 
       creditid ,
       max(PAYDATE) as paydat,sum(payedamt)payedamt from cm_payments p
      where payedamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE in(select max(paydate) from cm_payments where paydate<=sbop.get_date and creditid=p.creditid)
      group by creditid) LastMainPaydate      
      ,            
      ((select 
          id as creditid,
          null as paydat,0 payeddueintamt
        from cm_portfolio 
       minus
       select 
       creditid ,
       null as paydat, 0 payeddueintamt from cm_payments p
      where payeddueintamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE in(select max(paydate) from cm_payments where paydate<=sbop.get_date and creditid=p.creditid)
      group by creditid)
      union all
      select  
       creditid ,
       max(PAYDATE) as paydat,sum(payeddueintamt) payeddueintamt from cm_payments p
      where payeddueintamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE in(select max(paydate) from cm_payments where paydate<=sbop.get_date and creditid=p.creditid)
      group by creditid) dLastintPaydate,     
      ((select 
          id as creditid,
          null as paydat,0 payeddueamt
        from cm_portfolio 
       minus
       select 
       creditid ,
       null as paydat, 0 payeddueamt from cm_payments p
      where payeddueamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE in(select max(paydate) from cm_payments where paydate<=sbop.get_date and creditid=p.creditid)
      group by creditid)
      union all
      select 
       creditid ,
       max(PAYDATE) as paydat, sum(payeddueamt) payeddueamt from cm_payments p
      where payeddueamt<>0  
      and PAYDATE in(select max(paydate) from cm_payments where paydate<=sbop.get_date and creditid=p.creditid)
      group by creditid) dLastMainPaydate
where p.id=h.creditid and
p.id=b.creditid and
p.qovid=q.id and
p.id=gr.creditid(+)  and h.rest+h.duerest+h.interestrest+h.interestrest>0 and
p.BRANCHID=f.id and
p.id=fl.creditid(+) and
fl.status(+)=1 and 
p.currency=v.valute  and p.credittype=cr.id
  and LastintPaydate.creditid(+) = p.id
  and LastMainPaydate.creditid(+) = p.id  and dLastintPaydate.creditid = p.id and dLastMainPaydate.creditid(+) = p.id
    and p.id=g1.creditid(+) and g1.cardid(+)=1
    and p.id=g2.creditid(+) and g2.cardid(+)=2
    and p.id=g3.creditid(+) and g3.cardid(+)=3
order by :OrderField

select p.id, b.name,v.val_name ,p.numberofcredit,m.name name1, pa.paydate,pa.payedamt*o.ostat payedamt,
pa.payedintamt*o.ostat payedintamt,pa.payeddueamt*o.ostat payeddueamt,pa.payedpenaltyamt*o.ostat payedpenaltyamt,pa.dueday
 ,payedamt*o.ostat+payedintamt*o.ostat+payeddueamt*o.ostat+payedpenaltyamt*o.ostat sumpay,o.ostat from 
(select creditid, max(paydate)paydate, sum(payedamt)payedamt,sum(payedintamt)payedintamt,sum(payeddueamt)payeddueamt,
sum(payeddueintamt) payedpenaltyamt,min(dueday)dueday
 from cm_payments where paydate between :bdat and :edat 
 
 group by creditid) pa,cm_folderplace f,cm_mehkeme m, cm_portfolio p,cm_boorowerinfo b,operkurs o,avalute_t v
 
 where pa.creditid=f.creditid and p.currency=o.val_kod and o.dat=pa.paydate and p.currency=v.valute
 and f.qovidreciver=4 and
 f.senddate =(select max(senddate) from cm_folderplace where creditid=p.id ) and
 f.mehid=m.id and
 p.id=pa.creditid and p.id=b.creditid and 
f.mehid in ( select icra_id from cm_folder_icra where usid=:usid )
